notes: «أبي ره بهذا الإسناد» opens with a back reference and the context carries no previous report: the chain is read as written, with «بهذا الإسناد» kept as a back_reference
«قال قال أبو عبد الله ع» : the Imam named in the words after the chain is the last link (owner ruling 2); «ره» and «ع» are honorifics
